command: set -e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "613c6d427b4b753aab3c5aa05d73815f4fadb01e"; SERIAL=192.168.0.100:34771; echo '=== STATUS ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py status; echo '=== AUDIO POLICY TELEPHONY ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys media.audio_policy | grep -i -E -C 5 'telephony|AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_TELEPHONY_TX|AUDIO_DEVICE_IN_TELEPHONY_RX' | head -n 500 || true; echo '=== AUDIO FLINGER TELEPHONY ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys media.audio_flinger | grep -i -E -C 5 'telephony|AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_TELEPHONY_TX|AUDIO_DEVICE_IN_TELEPHONY_RX' | head -n 300 || true; echo '=== AUDIO SERVICE TELEPHONY ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -E -C 4 'telephony|in_call|mode' | head -n 300 || true; echo '=== VENDOR POLICY XML TELEPHONY ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'for d in /vendor/etc /odm/etc /system/etc; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; for f in "$d"/*audio*.xml "$d"/*policy*.xml; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; grep -Hni -E "TELEPHONY_TX|TELEPHONY_RX|telephony" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done; done' | head -n 500; echo audit_complete=true
